summary: v1.3 SurfCoach23 CRITICAL bug fixes verified GREEN end-to-end. New /app/backend/tests/test_v13_bugfixes.py covers all 3 bugs (quota for plus user, 3-upload Plus enforcement + 402 on 4th, _apply_subscription_if_paid sets tier=plan_id for both plus AND coach) — 5/5 PASS. Full backend regression: 71 passed / 3 skipped / 1 known pre-existing test-ordering failure (test_surfai_api::test_create_analysis_uploads_and_runs_gemini, free quota already used by earlier test in suite — same as iteration_5, NOT a v1.3 regression). Frontend paywall hero now correctly renders 'SURFCOACH · 23' (was 'SURF · COACH'); upgrade-plus-btn shows 'Get Plus – $9.99/mo' and upgrade-coach-btn shows 'Upgrade to Coach – $120/mo'. Demo user restored to tier='free' after run as required.

minor.issue: Pre-existing test-ordering issue (already documented in iteration_5): test_surfai_api::test_create_analysis_uploads_and_runs_gemini fails with 402 because earlier suite tests consume the free user's 1/day quota. Not a v1.3 regression — runs PASS when test is executed in isolation against a fresh free user.

Pre-existing v1.2 limitation: Stripe lookup for fake session_ids returns 404, _apply_subscription_if_paid degrades gracefully using DB payment_status. Confirmed correct behaviour — applies tier=plan_id when txn.payment_status=='paid'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1164 lines (PLANS + TIER_DAILY_LIMITS + _is_paid_active + _refresh_tier_if_expired + _apply_subscription_if_paid). Recommend extracting payments/subscription logic into routers/payments.py to keep server.py under 700 lines.

_apply_subscription_if_paid still references _is_coach_active(user_doc) on line 995 to extend an existing expiry — for a Plus user mid-cycle who upgrades to another plan, the helper should likely be _is_paid_active so plus expiry is also extended. Edge case, low priority.

Bug fix correctly implemented: get_quota uses TIER_DAILY_LIMITS.get(user.tier, FREE_DAILY_LIMIT); create_analysis enforces same lookup with limit==-1 = unlimited; _apply_subscription_if_paid sets tier=plan_id (not hardcoded 'coach'); _refresh_tier_if_expired now demotes both 'coach' and 'plus' via _is_paid_active. All 4 fixes are clean.
